description: Small redistributable synthetic tasks covering the v0.3 ontology; suitable for plumbing and local model experiments.

tasks.prompt: Source: The cedar box weighs 4 kg. State only its weight.
[S1] Rowan arrived Tuesday. State when Rowan arrived and cite S1.
Change only foo to bar in: foo = 3
Repair: def double(x): return x + x + 1. Return only the corrected return statement.
Review only; do not edit. Code: if user.is_admin: allow=False. Name the likely defect.
Constraint A=red. Distraction: B=blue. Return A only.
A lamp fails after a bulb replacement; a known-good bulb also fails. Name the likelier next hypothesis.
Return JSON with integer field answer set to 5.
Rename heading Old to New. Return only the new heading.
